<?php
namespace OmniAI\Modules;

if (!defined('ABSPATH')) {
    exit;
}

/**
 * مدیریت تزریق متاتگ‌های سئو و اسکیماهای ساختاریافته (JSON-LD)
 * AEO / GEO / Speakable / FAQPage / HowTo / Review / BlogPosting / Organization / Product
 */
class Schema_Injector {

    public function register(): void {
        add_action('wp_head', [$this, 'output_frontend_seo_tags'], 1);
        add_action('wp_head', [$this, 'output_webmaster_verification_tags'], 1);
        add_filter('pre_get_document_title', [$this, 'filter_document_title'], 15);
        add_filter('document_title_parts', [$this, 'filter_document_title_parts'], 15);
        add_action('wp_head', [$this, 'output_frontend_schemas'], 99);
        add_filter('the_content', [$this, 'filter_content_breadcrumbs'], 5);
    }

    /**
     * تزریق کدهای تأیید وب‌مستر تولز (گوگل، بینگ، پینترست، یاندکس، بایدو)
     */
    public function output_webmaster_verification_tags(): void {
        $options = get_option('omni_ai_ranking_settings', []);

        $verifications = [
            'google_verify'    => 'google-site-verification',
            'bing_verify'      => 'msvalidate.01',
            'pinterest_verify' => 'p:domain_verify',
            'yandex_verify'    => 'yandex-verification',
            'baidu_verify'     => 'baidu-site-verification',
        ];

        foreach ($verifications as $opt_key => $meta_name) {
            if (!empty($options[$opt_key])) {
                $val = trim((string) $options[$opt_key]);
                if (preg_match('/content=[\'"]([^\'"]+)[\'"]/i', $val, $matches)) {
                    $val = $matches[1];
                }
                echo '<meta name="' . esc_attr($meta_name) . '" content="' . esc_attr($val) . '" />' . "\n";
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * افزودن خودکار بردکرامب (مسیر راهنما) به ابتدای محتوای نوشته در صورت فعال بودن
     */
    public function filter_content_breadcrumbs(string $content): string {
        if (!is_singular('post')) {
            return $content;
        }

        $options = get_option('omni_ai_ranking_settings', []);
        if (!empty($options['auto_insert_breadcrumbs']) && class_exists('\\OmniAI\\Modules\\Breadcrumbs')) {
            $breadcrumbs_html = Breadcrumbs::render_html();
            return $breadcrumbs_html . "\n" . $content;
        }

        return $content;
    }

    /**
     * تزریق متاتگ‌های سئو، شبکه‌های اجتماعی (Open Graph) و توییتر
     */
    public function output_frontend_seo_tags(): void {
        if (!is_singular()) {
            return;
        }
        $post_id = get_the_ID();
        if (!$post_id) {
            return;
        }

        $is_other_seo = defined('WPSEO_VERSION') || defined('RANK_MATH_VERSION') || defined('AIOSEO_VERSION') || defined('SEOPRESS_VERSION');
        if ($is_other_seo) {
            return;
        }

        $meta_desc = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_meta_description', true);
        if (!empty($meta_desc)) {
            echo '<meta name="description" content="' . esc_attr($meta_desc) . '" />' . "\n";
        }

        $noindex  = get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_noindex', true);
        $nofollow = get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_nofollow', true);
        $robots = [];
        $robots[] = ($noindex === '1') ? 'noindex' : 'index';
        $robots[] = ($nofollow === '1') ? 'nofollow' : 'follow';
        echo '<meta name="robots" content="' . esc_attr(implode(', ', $robots)) . ', max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large, max-video-preview:-1" />' . "\n";

        $canonical = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_canonical_url', true);
        if (!empty($canonical)) {
            echo '<link rel="canonical" href="' . esc_url($canonical) . '" />' . "\n";
        } else {
            echo '<link rel="canonical" href="' . esc_url(get_permalink($post_id)) . '" />' . "\n";
        }

        // Open Graph & Social Meta Tags
        $post = get_post($post_id);
        $seo_title = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_seo_title', true) ?: ($post ? $post->post_title : '');
        $og_title  = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_og_title', true) ?: (string) get_post_meta($post_id, 'rank_math_facebook_title', true) ?: $seo_title;
        $og_desc   = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_og_description', true) ?: (string) get_post_meta($post_id, 'rank_math_facebook_description', true) ?: $meta_desc;
        
        $og_image  = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_og_image', true) ?: (string) get_post_meta($post_id, 'rank_math_facebook_image', true);
        if (empty($og_image) && has_post_thumbnail($post_id)) {
            $og_image = (string) get_the_post_thumbnail_url($post_id, 'large');
        }

        $twitter_title = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_twitter_title', true) ?: (string) get_post_meta($post_id, 'rank_math_twitter_title', true) ?: $og_title;
        $twitter_desc  = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_twitter_description', true) ?: (string) get_post_meta($post_id, 'rank_math_twitter_description', true) ?: $og_desc;
        $twitter_image = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_twitter_image', true) ?: (string) get_post_meta($post_id, 'rank_math_twitter_image', true) ?: $og_image;

        $permalink = get_permalink($post_id);
        $site_name = get_bloginfo('name');
        $locale    = get_locale() ?: 'fa_IR';

        echo '<meta property="og:locale" content="' . esc_attr($locale) . '" />' . "\n";
        echo '<meta property="og:type" content="' . (is_singular('post') ? 'article' : 'website') . '" />' . "\n";
        echo '<meta property="og:title" content="' . esc_attr($og_title) . '" />' . "\n";
        if (!empty($og_desc)) {
            echo '<meta property="og:description" content="' . esc_attr($og_desc) . '" />' . "\n";
        }
        echo '<meta property="og:url" content="' . esc_url($permalink) . '" />' . "\n";
        echo '<meta property="og:site_name" content="' . esc_attr($site_name) . '" />' . "\n";

        if (!empty($og_image)) {
            echo '<meta property="og:image" content="' . esc_url($og_image) . '" />' . "\n";
            echo '<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200" />' . "\n";
            echo '<meta property="og:image:height" content="630" />' . "\n";
        }

        if (is_singular('post') && $post) {
            echo '<meta property="article:published_time" content="' . esc_attr(get_post_time('c', true, $post_id)) . '" />' . "\n";
            echo '<meta property="article:modified_time" content="' . esc_attr(get_post_modified_time('c', true, $post_id)) . '" />' . "\n";
            $cats = wp_get_post_categories($post_id, ['fields' => 'names']);
            if (!empty($cats) && is_array($cats)) {
                echo '<meta property="article:section" content="' . esc_attr($cats[0]) . '" />' . "\n";
            }
        }

        // Twitter Cards
        echo '<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />' . "\n";
        echo '<meta name="twitter:title" content="' . esc_attr($twitter_title) . '" />' . "\n";
        if (!empty($twitter_desc)) {
            echo '<meta name="twitter:description" content="' . esc_attr($twitter_desc) . '" />' . "\n";
        }
        if (!empty($twitter_image)) {
            echo '<meta name="twitter:image" content="' . esc_url($twitter_image) . '" />' . "\n";
        }
    }

    public function filter_document_title(string $title): string {
        if (is_singular()) {
            $post_id = get_the_ID();
            if ($post_id) {
                $is_other_seo = defined('WPSEO_VERSION') || defined('RANK_MATH_VERSION') || defined('AIOSEO_VERSION');
                if (!$is_other_seo) {
                    $custom_title = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_seo_title', true);
                    if (!empty($custom_title)) {
                        return esc_html($custom_title);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return $title;
    }

    public function filter_document_title_parts(array $parts): array {
        if (is_singular()) {
            $post_id = get_the_ID();
            if ($post_id) {
                $is_other_seo = defined('WPSEO_VERSION') || defined('RANK_MATH_VERSION') || defined('AIOSEO_VERSION');
                if (!$is_other_seo) {
                    $custom_title = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_seo_title', true);
                    if (!empty($custom_title)) {
                        $parts['title'] = esc_html($custom_title);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return $parts;
    }

    /**
     * خروجی اسکیماهای ساختاریافته (JSON-LD) در فرانت‌اند
     */
    public function output_frontend_schemas(): void {
        $options = get_option('omni_ai_ranking_settings', []);
        $enable_schemas = $options['enable_schemas'] ?? true;
        if (!$enable_schemas) {
            return;
        }

        $schemas = [];

        // ۱. اسکیمای سازمان یا کسب‌وکار محلی (Organization / LocalBusiness) در صفحه اصلی
        if ((is_front_page() || is_home()) && ($options['enable_org_schema'] ?? true)) {
            $org_type = !empty($options['org_type']) ? sanitize_text_field($options['org_type']) : 'Organization';
            $org_name = !empty($options['org_name']) ? sanitize_text_field($options['org_name']) : get_bloginfo('name');
            $org_schema = [
                '@context' => 'https://schema.org',
                '@type'    => $org_type,
                'name'     => $org_name,
                'url'      => home_url('/'),
            ];
            if (!empty($options['org_logo'])) {
                $org_schema['logo'] = esc_url($options['org_logo']);
            }
            if (!empty($options['org_phone'])) {
                $org_schema['telephone'] = sanitize_text_field($options['org_phone']);
            }
            if (!empty($options['org_price_range'])) {
                $org_schema['priceRange'] = sanitize_text_field($options['org_price_range']);
            }
            $schemas[] = $org_schema;
        }

        // ۲. اسکیمای مسیر راهنما (BreadcrumbList)
        if (!is_front_page() && ($options['enable_breadcrumb_schema'] ?? true) && class_exists('\\OmniAI\\Modules\\Breadcrumbs')) {
            $bc_schema = Breadcrumbs::get_schema();
            if (!empty($bc_schema)) {
                $schemas[] = $bc_schema;
            }
        }

        // ۳. اسکیماهای اختصاصی صفحات تکی (مقاله‌ها، برگه‌ها و پست تایپ‌ها)
        if (is_singular()) {
            $post_id = get_the_ID();
            if ($post_id) {
                $content = get_post_field('post_content', $post_id);
                $post = get_post($post_id);

                // ۳-۱. اسکیمای Speakable (AEO - جستجوی صوتی)
                if (($options['enable_speakable'] ?? true) && (strpos($content, 'omni-direct-answer') !== false || strpos($content, 'omni-direct-answer-box') !== false)) {
                    $schemas[] = [
                        '@context'   => 'https://schema.org',
                        '@type'      => 'WebPage',
                        'speakable'  => [
                            '@type'       => 'SpeakableSpecification',
                            'cssSelector' => ['.omni-direct-answer-box', '.omni-direct-answer-box p'],
                        ],
                        'url'        => get_permalink($post_id),
                    ];
                }

                // ۳-۲. اسکیمای FAQPage ساختاریافته
                if ($options['enable_faq_schema'] ?? true) {
                    $faqs = $this->extract_faqs_for_schema($content);
                    if (!empty($faqs)) {
                        $main_entities = [];
                        foreach ($faqs as $faq) {
                            $main_entities[] = [
                                '@type'          => 'Question',
                                'name'           => $faq['q'],
                                'acceptedAnswer' => [
                                    '@type' => 'Answer',
                                    'text'  => $faq['a'],
                                ],
                            ];
                        }
                        $schemas[] = [
                            '@context'   => 'https://schema.org',
                            '@type'      => 'FAQPage',
                            'mainEntity' => $main_entities,
                        ];
                    }
                }

                // نوع اسکیمای انتخاب شده توسط کاربر در متاباکس
                $schema_type = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_schema_type', true) ?: 'article';

                // ۳-۳. اسکیمای HowTo (آموزش گام‌به‌گام)
                if ($schema_type === 'howto' && ($options['enable_howto_schema'] ?? true)) {
                    $howto_raw = get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_howto_data', true);
                    $howto_data = is_array($howto_raw) ? $howto_raw : (json_decode((string) $howto_raw, true) ?: []);

                    $howto_steps = [];
                    if (!empty($howto_data['steps']) && is_array($howto_data['steps'])) {
                        foreach ($howto_data['steps'] as $idx => $s) {
                            $howto_steps[] = [
                                '@type' => 'HowToStep',
                                'position' => $idx + 1,
                                'name'  => sanitize_text_field($s['title'] ?? ('مرحله ' . ($idx + 1))),
                                'text'  => sanitize_textarea_field($s['text'] ?? ''),
                            ];
                        }
                    }

                    $schemas[] = [
                        '@context'    => 'https://schema.org',
                        '@type'       => 'HowTo',
                        'name'        => !empty($howto_data['name']) ? sanitize_text_field($howto_data['name']) : $post->post_title,
                        'description' => !empty($howto_data['description']) ? sanitize_textarea_field($howto_data['description']) : wp_trim_words($content, 35),
                        'totalTime'   => !empty($howto_data['total_time']) ? sanitize_text_field($howto_data['total_time']) : 'PT15M',
                        'step'        => $howto_steps,
                    ];
                }
                // ۳-۴. اسکیمای Review (نقد و بررسی و امتیازدهی ستاره‌ای)
                elseif ($schema_type === 'review' && ($options['enable_review_schema'] ?? true)) {
                    $review_item = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_review_item', true) ?: $post->post_title;
                    $review_rating = (float) (get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_review_rating', true) ?: 5.0);
                    $author_name = get_the_author_meta('display_name', $post->post_author) ?: get_bloginfo('name');

                    $schemas[] = [
                        '@context'      => 'https://schema.org',
                        '@type'         => 'Review',
                        'itemReviewed'  => [
                            '@type' => 'Thing',
                            'name'  => sanitize_text_field($review_item),
                        ],
                        'reviewRating'  => [
                            '@type'       => 'Rating',
                            'ratingValue' => max(1.0, min(5.0, $review_rating)),
                            'bestRating'  => 5,
                            'worstRating' => 1,
                        ],
                        'author'        => [
                            '@type' => 'Person',
                            'name'  => $author_name,
                        ],
                        'reviewBody'    => wp_trim_words($content, 40),
                    ];
                }
                // ۳-۵. اسکیمای استاندارد BlogPosting همراه با نهادها (Entities & Mentions برای GEO)
                elseif ($schema_type === 'article' && ($options['enable_article_schema'] ?? true) && is_singular('post')) {
                    if ($post) {
                        $author_name = get_the_author_meta('display_name', $post->post_author) ?: get_bloginfo('name');
                        $raw_tags = wp_get_post_tags($post_id, ['fields' => 'names']);
                        $raw_cats = wp_get_post_categories($post_id, ['fields' => 'names']);
                        $tags = (!is_wp_error($raw_tags) && is_array($raw_tags)) ? $raw_tags : [];
                        $cats = (!is_wp_error($raw_cats) && is_array($raw_cats)) ? $raw_cats : [];
                        $keywords = array_merge($cats, $tags);
                        $thumb_id = get_post_thumbnail_id($post_id);
                        $thumb_url = $thumb_id ? wp_get_attachment_url($thumb_id) : '';

                        $about_entities = [];
                        foreach (array_slice($keywords, 0, 8) as $kw) {
                            if (is_string($kw) && trim($kw) !== '') {
                                $about_entities[] = [
                                    '@type' => 'Thing',
                                    'name'  => sanitize_text_field($kw),
                                ];
                            }
                        }

                        $article_schema = [
                            '@context'         => 'https://schema.org',
                            '@type'            => 'BlogPosting',
                            'mainEntityOfPage' => [
                                '@type' => 'WebPage',
                                '@id'   => get_permalink($post_id),
                            ],
                            'headline'         => $post->post_title,
                            'datePublished'    => get_the_date('c', $post_id),
                            'dateModified'     => get_the_modified_date('c', $post_id),
                            'author'           => [
                                '@type' => 'Person',
                                'name'  => $author_name,
                            ],
                            'publisher'        => [
                                '@type' => 'Organization',
                                'name'  => get_bloginfo('name'),
                                'url'   => home_url('/'),
                            ],
                        ];

                        if (!empty($keywords)) {
                            $article_schema['keywords'] = implode(', ', $keywords);
                        }
                        if (!empty($thumb_url)) {
                            $article_schema['image'] = $thumb_url;
                        }
                        if (!empty($about_entities)) {
                            $article_schema['about'] = $about_entities;
                        }

                        $schemas[] = $article_schema;
                    }
                }
                // ۳-۶. اسکیمای Product برای ووکامرس و محصولات فروشگاهی
                elseif (($schema_type === 'product' || is_singular('product') || ($post && $post->post_type === 'product')) && ($options['enable_product_schema'] ?? true)) {
                    $meta_desc = (string) get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_meta_description', true);
                    $prod_schema = [
                        '@context'    => 'https://schema.org',
                        '@type'       => 'Product',
                        'name'        => $post ? $post->post_title : '',
                        'description' => wp_strip_all_tags($meta_desc ?: wp_trim_words($content, 40)),
                        'url'         => get_permalink($post_id),
                    ];
                    $thumb_id = get_post_thumbnail_id($post_id);
                    if ($thumb_id) {
                        $prod_schema['image'] = wp_get_attachment_url($thumb_id);
                    }

                    if (function_exists('wc_get_product')) {
                        $wc_prod = wc_get_product($post_id);
                        if ($wc_prod) {
                            $prod_schema['name'] = $wc_prod->get_name();
                            $prod_schema['sku']  = $wc_prod->get_sku() ?: ('PROD-' . $post_id);
                            $currency = function_exists('get_woocommerce_currency') ? get_woocommerce_currency() : 'IRT';
                            $prod_schema['offers'] = [
                                '@type'         => 'Offer',
                                'price'         => $wc_prod->get_price() ?: '0',
                                'priceCurrency' => $currency,
                                'availability'  => $wc_prod->is_in_stock() ? 'https://schema.org/InStock' : 'https://schema.org/OutOfStock',
                                'url'           => get_permalink($post_id),
                            ];
                            if ($wc_prod->get_rating_count() > 0) {
                                $prod_schema['aggregateRating'] = [
                                    '@type'       => 'AggregateRating',
                                    'ratingValue' => $wc_prod->get_average_rating(),
                                    'reviewCount' => $wc_prod->get_rating_count(),
                                ];
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        $prod_schema['offers'] = [
                            '@type'         => 'Offer',
                            'price'         => '0',
                            'priceCurrency' => 'IRT',
                            'availability'  => 'https://schema.org/InStock',
                            'url'           => get_permalink($post_id),
                        ];
                    }
                    $schemas[] = $prod_schema;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!empty($schemas)) {
            foreach ($schemas as $schema) {
                echo "\n<!-- Omni AI Suite (Structured Schema) -->\n";
                echo '<script type="application/ld+json">' . wp_json_encode($schema, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) . "</script>\n";
            }
        }
    }

    public function extract_faqs_for_schema(string $content): array {
        $faqs = [];
        if (preg_match('/<!-- omni-faq -->([\s\S]*?)<!-- \/omni-faq -->|<div class=[\'"]omni-faq-section[\'"][\s\S]*?<\/div>/iu', $content, $match)) {
            $block = $match[0];
            if (preg_match_all('/<h[3-4][^>]*>(.*?)<\/h[3-4]>\s*<p[^>]*>(.*?)<\/p>/iu', $block, $pairs, PREG_SET_ORDER)) {
                foreach ($pairs as $p) {
                    $q = trim(wp_strip_all_tags($p[1]));
                    $a = trim(wp_strip_all_tags($p[2]));
                    if (!empty($q) && !empty($a)) {
                        $faqs[] = ['q' => $q, 'a' => $a];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return $faqs;
    }
}

    public function handle_custom_login_request(): void {
        $settings = self::get_settings();
        $slug = $settings['custom_login_slug'] ?? '';
        if (empty($settings['enable_hide_login']) || empty($slug)) {
            return;
        }

        // Emergency bypass constant (can be set in wp-config.php)
        if (defined('OMNI_DISABLE_HIDE_LOGIN') && OMNI_DISABLE_HIDE_LOGIN) {
            return;
        }

        // Emergency recovery key check (?omni_recovery=XYZ)
        $recovery_key = $settings['hide_login_recovery_key'] ?? '';
        if (!empty($recovery_key) && isset($_GET['omni_recovery']) && hash_equals($recovery_key, (string) $_GET['omni_recovery'])) {
            return;
        }

        $request_uri = $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '';
        $raw_path = wp_parse_url($request_uri, PHP_URL_PATH) ?: '';
        $path = untrailingslashit(trim($raw_path, '/'));

        // Handle sub-directory WordPress installations (e.g. example.com/site/secret-login)
        $site_path = untrailingslashit(trim(wp_parse_url(home_url(), PHP_URL_PATH) ?: '', '/'));
        if (!empty($site_path) && str_starts_with($path, $site_path)) {
            $path = untrailingslashit(trim(substr($path, strlen($site_path)), '/'));
        }

        // 1. User is accessing the custom login slug
        if ($path === $slug) {
            $action = $_REQUEST['action'] ?? '';

            // If user is logged in and NOT logging out or doing postpass, redirect to admin dashboard
            if (is_user_logged_in() && !in_array($action, ['logout', 'postpass'], true)) {
                wp_safe_redirect(admin_url());
                exit;
            }

            // Tell WordPress we are executing wp-login.php
            $GLOBALS['pagenow'] = 'wp-login.php';
            status_header(200);

            require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-login.php';
            exit;
        }

        // 2. Block direct access to wp-login.php
        if (str_contains($raw_path, 'wp-login.php')) {
            // Allow AJAX, REST API, or post password verification
            if (wp_doing_ajax() || (defined('REST_REQUEST') && REST_REQUEST)) {
                return;
            }

            if (isset($_GET['action']) && $_GET['action'] === 'postpass') {
                return;
            }

            $this->block_unauthorized_access($settings);
        }

        // 3. Block unauthenticated access to wp-admin (so secret slug is never exposed to visitors/bots)
        $is_admin_request = is_admin() || str_contains($raw_path, 'wp-admin');
        if ($is_admin_request && !is_user_logged_in()) {
            if (wp_doing_ajax() || (defined('REST_REQUEST') && REST_REQUEST)) {
                return;
            }

            // Allow front-end AJAX requests hitting admin-ajax.php
            if (str_contains($raw_path, 'admin-ajax.php')) {
                return;
            }

            $this->block_unauthorized_access($settings);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Send 404 header and template or redirect to configured slug.
     */
    private function block_unauthorized_access(array $settings): void {
        $redirect_target = $settings['hide_login_redirect_slug'] ?? '404';
        if ($redirect_target === '404') {
            status_header(404);
            nocache_headers();
            $template_404 = get_404_template();
            if ($template_404 && file_exists($template_404)) {
                include $template_404;
            } else {
                wp_die(__('برگه مورد نظر یافت نشد.', 'omni-ai-suite'), '404 Not Found', ['response' => 404]);
            }
            exit;
        } else {
            wp_safe_redirect(home_url('/' . ltrim($redirect_target, '/')));
            exit;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get real client IP address considering proxy headers.
     */
    public static function get_client_ip(): string {
        $headers = [
            'HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP', // Cloudflare
            'HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR',  // Proxies / Load Balancers
            'HTTP_CLIENT_IP',
            'REMOTE_ADDR'
        ];

        foreach ($headers as $h) {
            if (!empty($_SERVER[$h])) {
                $raw = (string) $_SERVER[$h];
                if (str_contains($raw, ',')) {
                    $parts = explode(',', $raw);
                    $ip = trim($parts[0]);
                } else {
                    $ip = trim($raw);
                }
                if (filter_var($ip, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP)) {
                    return $ip;
                }
            }
        }

        return $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '127.0.0.1';
    }

    /**
     * Check if given IP matches a whitelist (supports single IPs and CIDR ranges).
     */
    public static function is_ip_whitelisted(string $client_ip, string $whitelist_str): bool {
        $whitelist = array_filter(array_map('trim', explode("\n", str_replace([',', ';'], "\n", $whitelist_str))));
        if (empty($whitelist)) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($whitelist as $allowed) {
            if ($allowed === '*' || $allowed === $client_ip) {
                return true;
            }
            // Subnet CIDR match (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24)
            if (str_contains($allowed, '/')) {
                [$subnet, $bits] = explode('/', $allowed);
                if (filter_var($subnet, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP, FILTER_FLAG_IPV4) && is_numeric($bits)) {
                    $ip_long = ip2long($client_ip);
                    $sub_long = ip2long($subnet);
                    if ($ip_long !== false && $sub_long !== false) {
                        $mask = -1 << (32 - (int)$bits);
                        if (($ip_long & $mask) === ($sub_long & $mask)) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Intercept and filter all REST API requests.
     */
    public function filter_rest_requests($result, $server, $request) {
        if (!($request instanceof \WP_REST_Request)) {
            return $result;
        }

        $route = $request->get_route();
        $settings = self::get_settings();
        $client_ip = self::get_client_ip();
        $is_admin = current_user_can('manage_options');

        // Whitelist Omni AI Suite plugin admin calls for admins to avoid self-lockout
        if ($is_admin && str_starts_with($route, '/omni-ai/v1/')) {
            return $result;
        }

        // Global IP Whitelist check
        $global_whitelist = trim($settings['global_ip_whitelist'] ?? '');
        $is_globally_whitelisted = !empty($global_whitelist) && self::is_ip_whitelisted($client_ip, $global_whitelist);

        // 1. Anti-Username Enumeration: Restrict /wp/v2/users for non-authenticated guests
        if (!empty($settings['block_user_enumeration'])) {
            if (str_starts_with($route, '/wp/v2/users') && !is_user_logged_in() && !$is_globally_whitelisted) {
                return new \WP_Error(
                    'rest_forbidden_user_enum',
                    __('دسترسی به فهرست کاربران برای عموم مسدود است.', 'omni-ai-suite'),
                    ['status' => 403]
                );
            }
        }

        // 2. Global REST Authentication requirement (except login/public endpoints)
        if (!empty($settings['require_rest_auth']) && !is_user_logged_in() && !$is_globally_whitelisted) {
            // Check if this specific route is explicitly configured as public in routes_config
            $routes_config = $settings['routes_config'] ?? [];
            $route_explicitly_public = false;
            if (is_array($routes_config)) {
                foreach ($routes_config as $target_pattern => $cfg) {
                    if (empty($cfg) || !is_array($cfg)) continue;
                    $matched = ($route === $target_pattern);
                    if (!$matched && str_ends_with($target_pattern, '*')) {
                        $prefix = rtrim($target_pattern, '*');
                        $matched = str_starts_with($route, $prefix);
                    }
                    if ($matched) {
                        // If admin configured this route as public (not requiring auth and not disabled)
                        if (empty($cfg['require_auth']) && empty($cfg['disabled'])) {
                            $route_explicitly_public = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Essential public endpoints for headless blog and embeds
            $default_public = [
                '/oembed/1.0/embed',
                '/omni-ai/v1',
                '/omni-ai/v1/posts',
                '/omni-ai/v1/categories',
            ];
            $public_allowed = apply_filters('omni_ai_public_rest_routes', $default_public);
            $is_public = $route_explicitly_public;

            if (!$is_public) {
                foreach ($public_allowed as $pub) {
                    if ($route === $pub || str_starts_with($route, rtrim($pub, '/') . '/')) {
                        $is_public = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!$is_public) {
                return new \WP_Error(
                    'rest_auth_required',
                    __('دسترسی به این اندپوینت نیازمند ورود به حساب کاربری است.', 'omni-ai-suite'),
                    ['status' => 401]
                );
            }
        }

        // 3. Per-Route Specific Rules
        $routes_config = $settings['routes_config'] ?? [];
        if (is_array($routes_config) && !empty($routes_config)) {
            foreach ($routes_config as $target_pattern => $cfg) {
                if (empty($cfg) || !is_array($cfg)) continue;

                // Match exact or prefix route
                $matched = ($route === $target_pattern);
                if (!$matched && str_ends_with($target_pattern, '*')) {
                    $prefix = rtrim($target_pattern, '*');
                    $matched = str_starts_with($route, $prefix);
                }

                if ($matched) {
                    // Check if route is disabled
                    if (!empty($cfg['disabled'])) {
                        // Allow if admin or specifically IP whitelisted
                        $route_whitelist = trim($cfg['ip_whitelist'] ?? '');
                        $has_ip_access = (!empty($route_whitelist) && self::is_ip_whitelisted($client_ip, $route_whitelist)) || $is_globally_whitelisted;

                        if (!$has_ip_access) {
                            return new \WP_Error(
                                'rest_route_disabled',
                                __('این اندپوینت REST API توسط مدیر سایت غیرفعال شده است.', 'omni-ai-suite'),
                                ['status' => 403]
                            );
                        }
                    }

                    // Check if route requires authentication
                    if (!empty($cfg['require_auth']) && !is_user_logged_in()) {
                        return new \WP_Error(
                            'rest_route_auth_required',
                            __('دسترسی به این مسیر فقط برای اعضای سایت مجاز است.', 'omni-ai-suite'),
                            ['status' => 401]
                        );
                    }

                    // Check route-specific IP whitelist if specified and route is active
                    $route_ip_whitelist = trim($cfg['ip_whitelist'] ?? '');
                    if (!empty($route_ip_whitelist)) {
                        if (!self::is_ip_whitelisted($client_ip, $route_ip_whitelist) && !$is_globally_whitelisted && !$is_admin) {
                            return new \WP_Error(
                                'rest_ip_blocked',
                                __('آی‌پی شما اجازه دسترسی به این اندپوینت را ندارد.', 'omni-ai-suite'),
                                ['status' => 403]
                            );
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * Prevent scanning author usernames via URL parameters like ?author=1
     */
    public function block_author_query_scan(): void {
        if (!is_admin() && !is_user_logged_in() && isset($_GET['author'])) {
            wp_safe_redirect(home_url(), 301);
            exit;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Strip WordPress query version strings from CSS & JS.
     */
    public function remove_ver_query(string $src): string {
        if (str_contains($src, 'ver=')) {
            $src = remove_query_arg('ver', $src);
        }
        return $src;
    }

    /**
     * Add essential security HTTP response headers.
     */
    public function send_security_headers(): void {
        if (!headers_sent()) {
            header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
            header('X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN');
            header('X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block');
            header('Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
        }
    }
}

<?php
namespace OmniAI\Modules;

if (!defined('ABSPATH')) {
    exit;
}

/**
 * ماژول نقشه سایت هوشمند و فوق‌العاده سریع XML (Sitemap Engine)
 * تولید نقشه سایت استاندارد XML برای نوشته‌ها، برگه‌ها، دسته‌بندی‌ها و تصاویر با حذف خودکار موارد noindex
 */
class Sitemap_Module implements Module_Interface {

    public const CACHE_PREFIX = 'omni_sitemap_cache_';
    public const CACHE_TTL    = 43200; // 12 hours

    public function get_id(): string {
        return 'sitemap';
    }

    public function get_title(): string {
        return 'نقشه سایت هوشمند XML (Sitemap Engine)';
    }

    public function get_description(): string {
        return 'تولید نقشه سایت XML بسیار سریع و سبک با پشتیبانی از تصاویر، دسته‌ها و حذف خودکار صفحات noindex.';
    }

    public function is_active(): bool {
        $states = get_option('omni_ai_modules', []);
        return !isset($states[$this->get_id()]) || (bool) $states[$this->get_id()];
    }

    public function register(): void {
        // ۱. بازنویسی قوانین آدرس‌ها (Rewrite Rules)
        add_action('init', [$this, 'register_rewrite_rules']);
        add_filter('query_vars', [$this, 'register_query_vars']);
        add_action('template_redirect', [$this, 'handle_sitemap_request']);

        // ۲. پاکسازی خودکار کش نقشه سایت هنگام ویرایش محتوا
        add_action('save_post', [$this, 'clear_sitemap_cache']);
        add_action('deleted_post', [$this, 'clear_sitemap_cache']);
        add_action('create_category', [$this, 'clear_sitemap_cache']);
        add_action('edited_category', [$this, 'clear_sitemap_cache']);
        add_action('delete_category', [$this, 'clear_sitemap_cache']);

        // ۳. غیرفعال کردن نقشه سایت پیش‌فرض سنگین وردپرس جهت جلوگیری از تداخل
        add_filter('wp_sitemaps_enabled', '__return_false');
    }

    public function register_rewrite_rules(): void {
        add_rewrite_rule('^sitemap\.xml$', 'index.php?omni_sitemap=index', 'top');
        add_rewrite_rule('^sitemap_index\.xml$', 'index.php?omni_sitemap=index', 'top');
        add_rewrite_rule('^sitemap-([a-z0-9_-]+)\.xml$', 'index.php?omni_sitemap=$matches[1]', 'top');
    }

    public function register_query_vars(array $vars): array {
        $vars[] = 'omni_sitemap';
        return $vars;
    }

    public function clear_sitemap_cache(): void {
        delete_transient(self::CACHE_PREFIX . 'index');
        delete_transient(self::CACHE_PREFIX . 'posts');
        delete_transient(self::CACHE_PREFIX . 'pages');
        delete_transient(self::CACHE_PREFIX . 'categories');
    }

    public function handle_sitemap_request(): void {
        $sitemap_type = get_query_var('omni_sitemap');
        if (empty($sitemap_type)) {
            return;
        }

        $sitemap_type = sanitize_key($sitemap_type);
        $cache_key = self::CACHE_PREFIX . $sitemap_type;
        $xml = get_transient($cache_key);

        if ($xml === false || empty($xml)) {
            switch ($sitemap_type) {
                case 'index':
                    $xml = $this->generate_index_sitemap();
                    break;
                case 'posts':
                    $xml = $this->generate_posts_sitemap();
                    break;
                case 'pages':
                    $xml = $this->generate_pages_sitemap();
                    break;
                case 'categories':
                    $xml = $this->generate_categories_sitemap();
                    break;
                default:
                    return;
            }

            if (!empty($xml)) {
                set_transient($cache_key, $xml, self::CACHE_TTL);
            }
        }

        if (empty($xml)) {
            global $wp_query;
            $wp_query->set_404();
            status_header(404);
            return;
        }

        // ارسال هدرهای بهینه
        header('Content-Type: application/xml; charset=utf-8');
        header('X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow');
        header('Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600');

        echo $xml;
        exit;
    }

    /**
     * تولید نقشه اصلی (Sitemap Index)
     */
    private function generate_index_sitemap(): string {
        $home = home_url();
        $now  = current_time('c');

        // دریافت تاریخ آخرین ویرایش پست‌ها
        $latest_post = get_posts([
            'numberposts' => 1,
            'post_status' => 'publish',
            'post_type'   => 'post',
            'orderby'     => 'modified',
            'order'       => 'DESC',
        ]);
        $posts_lastmod = !empty($latest_post) ? get_post_modified_time('c', true, $latest_post[0]->ID) : $now;

        $xml = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' . "\n";
        $xml .= '<sitemapindex xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">' . "\n";

        // ۱. نقشه پست‌ها
        $xml .= "  <sitemap>\n";
        $xml .= "    <loc>" . esc_url($home . '/sitemap-posts.xml') . "</loc>\n";
        $xml .= "    <lastmod>" . esc_html($posts_lastmod) . "</lastmod>\n";
        $xml .= "  </sitemap>\n";

        // ۲. نقشه برگه‌ها
        $xml .= "  <sitemap>\n";
        $xml .= "    <loc>" . esc_url($home . '/sitemap-pages.xml') . "</loc>\n";
        $xml .= "    <lastmod>" . esc_html($now) . "</lastmod>\n";
        $xml .= "  </sitemap>\n";

        // ۳. نقشه دسته‌بندی‌ها
        $xml .= "  <sitemap>\n";
        $xml .= "    <loc>" . esc_url($home . '/sitemap-categories.xml') . "</loc>\n";
        $xml .= "    <lastmod>" . esc_html($posts_lastmod) . "</lastmod>\n";
        $xml .= "  </sitemap>\n";

        $xml .= '</sitemapindex>';
        return $xml;
    }

    /**
     * تولید نقشه پست‌ها همراه با تصاویر شاخص
     */
    private function generate_posts_sitemap(): string {
        $posts = get_posts([
            'numberposts' => 1000,
            'post_status' => 'publish',
            'post_type'   => 'post',
            'orderby'     => 'modified',
            'order'       => 'DESC',
        ]);

        $xml = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' . "\n";
        $xml .= '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9" xmlns:image="http://www.google.com/schemas/sitemap-image/1.1">' . "\n";

        foreach ($posts as $post) {
            // بررسی دستور noindex (عدم ثبت صفحات noindex در نقشه سایت)
            if ($this->is_post_noindex($post->ID)) {
                continue;
            }

            $loc      = get_permalink($post->ID);
            $lastmod  = get_post_modified_time('c', true, $post->ID);
            $thumb_id = get_post_thumbnail_id($post->ID);
            $thumb_url = $thumb_id ? wp_get_attachment_url($thumb_id) : '';

            $xml .= "  <url>\n";
            $xml .= "    <loc>" . esc_url($loc) . "</loc>\n";
            $xml .= "    <lastmod>" . esc_html($lastmod) . "</lastmod>\n";
            $xml .= "    <changefreq>weekly</changefreq>\n";
            $xml .= "    <priority>0.8</priority>\n";

            if (!empty($thumb_url)) {
                $alt = get_post_meta($thumb_id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', true) ?: $post->post_title;
                $xml .= "    <image:image>\n";
                $xml .= "      <image:loc>" . esc_url($thumb_url) . "</image:loc>\n";
                $xml .= "      <image:title>" . esc_html(htmlspecialchars($alt, ENT_XML1, 'UTF-8')) . "</image:title>\n";
                $xml .= "    </image:image>\n";
            }

            $xml .= "  </url>\n";
        }

        $xml .= '</urlset>';
        return $xml;
    }

    /**
     * تولید نقشه برگه‌های سایت
     */
    private function generate_pages_sitemap(): string {
        $pages = get_pages([
            'number'      => 500,
            'post_status' => 'publish',
        ]);

        $xml = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' . "\n";
        $xml .= '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">' . "\n";

        // برگه اصلی سایت
        $xml .= "  <url>\n";
        $xml .= "    <loc>" . esc_url(home_url('/')) . "</loc>\n";
        $xml .= "    <lastmod>" . esc_html(current_time('c')) . "</lastmod>\n";
        $xml .= "    <changefreq>daily</changefreq>\n";
        $xml .= "    <priority>1.0</priority>\n";
        $xml .= "  </url>\n";

        foreach ($pages as $page) {
            if ($this->is_post_noindex($page->ID)) {
                continue;
            }

            $loc     = get_permalink($page->ID);
            $lastmod = get_post_modified_time('c', true, $page->ID);

            $xml .= "  <url>\n";
            $xml .= "    <loc>" . esc_url($loc) . "</loc>\n";
            $xml .= "    <lastmod>" . esc_html($lastmod) . "</lastmod>\n";
            $xml .= "    <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>\n";
            $xml .= "    <priority>0.6</priority>\n";
            $xml .= "  </url>\n";
        }

        $xml .= '</urlset>';
        return $xml;
    }

    /**
     * تولید نقشه دسته‌بندی‌ها
     */
    private function generate_categories_sitemap(): string {
        $terms = get_terms([
            'taxonomy'   => 'category',
            'hide_empty' => true,
        ]);

        $xml = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' . "\n";
        $xml .= '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">' . "\n";

        if (!is_wp_error($terms) && is_array($terms)) {
            foreach ($terms as $term) {
                $loc = get_term_link($term, 'category');
                if (is_wp_error($loc)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $xml .= "  <url>\n";
                $xml .= "    <loc>" . esc_url($loc) . "</loc>\n";
                $xml .= "    <changefreq>weekly</changefreq>\n";
                $xml .= "    <priority>0.5</priority>\n";
                $xml .= "  </url>\n";
            }
        }

        $xml .= '</urlset>';
        return $xml;
    }

    /**
     * بررسی هوشمند وضعیت noindex یک نوشته
     */
    private function is_post_noindex(int $post_id): bool {
        // ۱. بررسی متای بومی Omni AI
        $omni_noindex = get_post_meta($post_id, '_omni_ai_noindex', true);
        if ($omni_noindex === '1') {
            return true;
        }

        // ۲. بررسی سازگاری با رنک‌مث
        $rm_robots = get_post_meta($post_id, 'rank_math_robots', true);
        if (is_array($rm_robots) && in_array('noindex', $rm_robots, true)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (is_string($rm_robots) && strpos($rm_robots, 'noindex') !== false) {
            return true;
        }

        // ۳. بررسی سازگاری با یواست سئو
        $yoast_noindex = get_post_meta($post_id, '_yoast_wpseo_meta-robots-noindex', true);
        if ($yoast_noindex === '1') {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
}

    /**
     * Initial seed tools when storage is empty.
     */
    public static function get_default_seed_tools(): array {
        $dict = self::get_known_tools_dict();
        $kit_slugs = ['invoice-generator', 'qr-code-generator', 'barcode-generator', 'uuid-generator', 'password-generator', 'text-diff'];

        $seed = [];
        foreach ($dict as $slug => $meta) {
            $is_kit = in_array($slug, $kit_slugs, true);
            $domain = $is_kit ? 'kit.zebracode.ir' : 'zebracode.ir';
            $url = 'https://' . $domain . '/' . $slug;

            $seed[] = [
                'slug'        => $slug,
                'title'       => $meta['title'],
                'description' => $meta['description'],
                'url'         => $url,
                'domain'      => $domain,
            ];
        }

        return $seed;
    }

    /**
     * Get all synced tools, seeding with defaults if empty.
     */
    public static function get_synced_tools(): array {
        $tools = get_option(self::OPTION_SYNCED_TOOLS, null);
        if (!is_array($tools) || empty($tools)) {
            $tools = self::get_default_seed_tools();
            update_option(self::OPTION_SYNCED_TOOLS, $tools, false);
        }
        return array_values($tools);
    }

    /**
     * Check if a path/URL is a valid developer tool.
     */
    public static function parse_tool_url(string $loc): ?array {
        $loc = trim($loc);
        if (empty($loc)) {
            return null;
        }

        $parts = parse_url($loc);
        if (empty($parts['host'])) {
            return null;
        }

        $domain = strtolower($parts['host']);
        $raw_path = trim($parts['path'] ?? '', '/');

        if (empty($raw_path)) {
            return null; // Root home
        }

        // Normalize multilingual path (e.g. 'fa/json-format' or 'en/json-format')
        $clean_path = preg_replace('#^(en|fa)/#i', '', $raw_path);
        $clean_path = trim($clean_path, '/');

        if (empty($clean_path)) {
            return null;
        }

        $first_segment = strtolower(explode('/', $clean_path)[0]);
        $ignored_roots = [
            'blog', 'articles', 'category', 'tag', 'about', 'contact', 'privacy',
            'terms', 'robots.txt', 'sitemap.xml', 'icon.svg', 'feed', 'wp-admin',
            'wp-content', 'wp-includes', 'wp-json', 'page', 'author', 'search',
        ];

        if (in_array($first_segment, $ignored_roots, true)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Slug is the last meaningful segment
        $slug = basename($clean_path);
        $slug = preg_replace('/\.(html|php|xml|json|txt)$/i', '', $slug);
        $slug = sanitize_title($slug);

        if (empty($slug) || strlen($slug) < 2) {
            return null;
        }

        // Match against known dictionary
        $dict = self::get_known_tools_dict();
        if (isset($dict[$slug])) {
            $title = $dict[$slug]['title'];
            $description = $dict[$slug]['description'];
        } else {
            // Smart slug formatting
            $words = explode('-', $slug);
            $clean_words = array_map(function ($w) {
                if (in_array(strtolower($w), ['json', 'sql', 'css', 'js', 'html', 'jwt', 'url', 'uuid', 'api', 'regex', 'svg', 'csv', 'xml', 'md5', 'sha256'], true)) {
                    return strtoupper($w);
                }
                return ucfirst($w);
            }, $words);

            $title = 'ابزار آنلاین ' . implode(' ', $clean_words);
            $description = 'ابزار کاربردی توسعه‌دهندگان زبراکد در ' . $domain . '.';
        }

        // Canonical tool URL without extra trailing slashes or locale prefix
        $target_url = 'https://' . $domain . '/' . $slug;

        return [
            'slug'        => $slug,
            'title'       => $title,
            'description' => $description,
            'url'         => $target_url,
            'domain'      => $domain,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Crawl sitemaps and sync tools.
     */
    public static function sync_from_sitemaps(array $sitemap_urls): array {
        $normalized_sitemaps = [];
        foreach ($sitemap_urls as $u) {
            $u = trim((string) $u);
            if (empty($u)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!preg_match('#^https?://#i', $u)) {
                $u = 'https://' . $u;
            }
            if (!str_contains($u, '.xml') && !str_ends_with($u, 'sitemap')) {
                $u = rtrim($u, '/') . '/sitemap.xml';
            }
            $normalized_sitemaps[] = esc_url_raw($u);
        }

        $normalized_sitemaps = array_values(array_unique(array_filter($normalized_sitemaps)));
        if (empty($normalized_sitemaps)) {
            $normalized_sitemaps = self::get_default_sitemaps();
        }

        // Load existing tools to preserve user edits
        $existing_tools = self::get_synced_tools();
        $existing_by_slug = [];
        foreach ($existing_tools as $t) {
            if (!empty($t['slug'])) {
                $existing_by_slug[$t['slug']] = $t;
            }
        }

        $discovered_tools = [];
        $visited = [];
        $queue = $normalized_sitemaps;
        $max_fetches = 25;
        $fetches = 0;

        while (!empty($queue) && $fetches < $max_fetches) {
            $sitemap_url = array_shift($queue);
            if (isset($visited[$sitemap_url])) {
                continue;
            }
            $visited[$sitemap_url] = true;
            $fetches++;

            $response = wp_remote_get($sitemap_url, [
                'timeout'     => 12,
                'sslverify'   => false,
                'user-agent'  => 'OmniAISuite-SitemapCrawler/1.0 (+https://zebracode.ir)',
            ]);

            if (is_wp_error($response) || wp_remote_retrieve_response_code($response) !== 200) {
                continue;
            }

            $body = wp_remote_retrieve_body($response);
            if (empty($body)) {
                continue;
            }

            // Check for sitemap index
            if (preg_match_all('/<sitemap>\s*<loc>\s*([^<]+)\s*<\/loc>/is', $body, $sub_matches)) {
                foreach ($sub_matches[1] as $sub_url) {
                    $sub_url = trim($sub_url);
                    if (!isset($visited[$sub_url]) && count($queue) < 15) {
                        $queue[] = $sub_url;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Parse URLs
            if (preg_match_all('/<url>\s*<loc>\s*([^<]+)\s*<\/loc>/is', $body, $url_matches)) {
                foreach ($url_matches[1] as $loc) {
                    $tool = self::parse_tool_url($loc);
                    if ($tool) {
                        $slug = $tool['slug'];
                        // Preserve previous custom titles / descriptions if user customized them
                        if (isset($existing_by_slug[$slug])) {
                            $tool['title'] = $existing_by_slug[$slug]['title'] ?? $tool['title'];
                            $tool['description'] = $existing_by_slug[$slug]['description'] ?? $tool['description'];
                        }
                        $discovered_tools[$slug] = $tool;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // If crawler could not reach external domains (e.g. offline/local test), merge with seed tools
        if (empty($discovered_tools)) {
            $discovered_tools = $existing_by_slug ?: [];
            foreach (self::get_default_seed_tools() as $seed) {
                if (!isset($discovered_tools[$seed['slug']])) {
                    $discovered_tools[$seed['slug']] = $seed;
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Keep existing tools not found in sitemap if they were previously saved
            foreach ($existing_by_slug as $slug => $old_tool) {
                if (!isset($discovered_tools[$slug])) {
                    $discovered_tools[$slug] = $old_tool;
                }
            }
        }

        $final_tools = array_values($discovered_tools);
        update_option(self::OPTION_SYNCED_TOOLS, $final_tools, false);
        update_option(self::OPTION_SITEMAPS, $normalized_sitemaps, false);

        return [
            'success'      => true,
            'tools'        => $final_tools,
            'sitemap_urls' => $normalized_sitemaps,
            'count'        => count($final_tools),
            'message'      => sprintf(__('همگام‌سازی ابزارها با موفقیت انجام شد. %d ابزار ثبت شد.', 'omni-ai-suite'), count($final_tools)),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Save all tools manually from admin UI.
     */
    public static function save_all_tools(array $tools): array {
        $sanitized = [];
        foreach ($tools as $tool) {
            $slug = sanitize_title($tool['slug'] ?? '');
            if (empty($slug)) {
                continue;
            }
            $title = sanitize_text_field($tool['title'] ?? $slug);
            $desc = sanitize_textarea_field($tool['description'] ?? '');
            $url = esc_url_raw($tool['url'] ?? ('https://zebracode.ir/' . $slug));
            $domain = sanitize_text_field($tool['domain'] ?? parse_url($url, PHP_URL_HOST) ?? 'zebracode.ir');

            $sanitized[] = [
                'slug'        => $slug,
                'title'       => $title,
                'description' => $desc,
                'url'         => $url,
                'domain'      => $domain,
            ];
        }

        update_option(self::OPTION_SYNCED_TOOLS, $sanitized, false);

        return [
            'success' => true,
            'tools'   => $sanitized,
            'count'   => count($sanitized),
            'message' => __('تغییرات ابزارهای سایت با موفقیت ذخیره شد.', 'omni-ai-suite'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Add or update a single tool.
     */
    public static function add_or_update_tool(array $data): array {
        $tools = self::get_synced_tools();
        $slug = sanitize_title($data['slug'] ?? '');
        if (empty($slug)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => __('نامک (slug) ابزار الزامی است.', 'omni-ai-suite')];
        }

        $title = sanitize_text_field($data['title'] ?? $slug);
        $desc = sanitize_textarea_field($data['description'] ?? '');
        $url = esc_url_raw($data['url'] ?? ('https://zebracode.ir/' . $slug));
        $domain = sanitize_text_field($data['domain'] ?? parse_url($url, PHP_URL_HOST) ?? 'zebracode.ir');

        $updated = false;
        foreach ($tools as $idx => $t) {
            if ($t['slug'] === $slug) {
                $tools[$idx] = [
                    'slug'        => $slug,
                    'title'       => $title,
                    'description' => $desc,
                    'url'         => $url,
                    'domain'      => $domain,
                ];
                $updated = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!$updated) {
            array_unshift($tools, [
                'slug'        => $slug,
                'title'       => $title,
                'description' => $desc,
                'url'         => $url,
                'domain'      => $domain,
            ]);
        }

        update_option(self::OPTION_SYNCED_TOOLS, $tools, false);

        return [
            'success' => true,
            'tools'   => $tools,
            'message' => __('ابزار با موفقیت ذخیره شد.', 'omni-ai-suite'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Delete a tool by slug.
     */
    public static function delete_tool(string $slug): array {
        $slug = sanitize_title($slug);
        $tools = self::get_synced_tools();
        $filtered = array_values(array_filter($tools, function ($t) use ($slug) {
            return $t['slug'] !== $slug;
        }));

        update_option(self::OPTION_SYNCED_TOOLS, $filtered, false);

        return [
            'success' => true,
            'tools'   => $filtered,
            'message' => __('ابزار مورد نظر با موفقیت حذف شد.', 'omni-ai-suite'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Match and enrich related tools for a blog post.
     * Returns rich objects: [{ "slug", "title", "description", "url", "domain" }].
     */
    public static function enrich_post_tools(
        int $post_id,
        string $post_title = '',
        string $post_excerpt = '',
        string $category = '',
        string $focus_keyword = '',
        array $tags = []
    ): array {
        $synced_tools = self::get_synced_tools();
        $tools_by_slug = [];
        foreach ($synced_tools as $st) {
            if (!empty($st['slug'])) {
                $tools_by_slug[$st['slug']] = $st;
            }
        }

        // 1. Check if post has explicit related tools meta
        $raw_tools = get_post_meta($post_id, '_zebracode_blog_ai_related_tools', true);
        $selected_slugs = [];
        if (is_array($raw_tools)) {
            foreach ($raw_tools as $t) {
                if (is_string($t) && trim($t) !== '') {
                    $selected_slugs[] = sanitize_title($t);
                } elseif (is_array($t) && !empty($t['slug'])) {
                    $selected_slugs[] = sanitize_title($t['slug']);
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. If empty, auto-match up to 3 relevant tools based on content keywords
        if (empty($selected_slugs) && !empty($synced_tools)) {
            $post_text = mb_strtolower($post_title . ' ' . $post_excerpt . ' ' . $category . ' ' . $focus_keyword . ' ' . implode(' ', $tags));
            $scored = [];

            foreach ($synced_tools as $st) {
                $st_slug = $st['slug'] ?? '';
                $st_title = mb_strtolower($st['title'] ?? '');
                $st_desc = mb_strtolower($st['description'] ?? '');
                $score = 0;

                // Match slug parts
                $words = explode('-', $st_slug);
                foreach ($words as $w) {
                    if (strlen($w) > 2 && mb_strpos($post_text, $w) !== false) {
                        $score += 3;
                    }
                }

                // Match title keywords
                if (!empty($st_title)) {
                    $title_words = explode(' ', $st_title);
                    foreach ($title_words as $tw) {
                        if (strlen($tw) > 3 && mb_strpos($post_text, $tw) !== false) {
                            $score += 2;
                        }
                    }
                }

                $scored[] = ['slug' => $st_slug, 'score' => $score];
            }

            usort($scored, function ($a, $b) {
                return $b['score'] <=> $a['score'];
            });

            $count = 0;
            foreach ($scored as $item) {
                if ($count >= 3) {
                    break;
                }
                $selected_slugs[] = $item['slug'];
                $count++;
            }
        }

        // 3. Format as rich objects
        $enriched = [];
        foreach ($selected_slugs as $slug) {
            if (isset($tools_by_slug[$slug])) {
                $tool = $tools_by_slug[$slug];
                $enriched[] = [
                    'slug'        => $tool['slug'],
                    'title'       => $tool['title'],
                    'description' => $tool['description'],
                    'url'         => !empty($tool['url']) ? $tool['url'] : 'https://zebracode.ir/' . $tool['slug'],
                    'domain'      => $tool['domain'] ?? 'zebracode.ir',
                ];
            } else {
                // Fallback for custom slug
                $dict = self::get_known_tools_dict();
                $known = $dict[$slug] ?? null;
                $enriched[] = [
                    'slug'        => $slug,
                    'title'       => $known ? $known['title'] : ucwords(str_replace('-', ' ', $slug)),
                    'description' => $known ? $known['description'] : 'ابزار کاربردی توسعه‌دهندگان زبراکد.',
                    'url'         => 'https://zebracode.ir/' . $slug,
                    'domain'      => 'zebracode.ir',
                ];
            }
        }

        return $enriched;
    }
}

<?php
namespace OmniAI\Providers;

if (!defined('ABSPATH')) {
    exit;

/**
 * Anthropic Claude Provider implementation.
 */
class Claude_Provider implements AI_Provider_Interface {
    private string $api_key;
    private string $default_model;

    public function __construct(string $api_key = '', string $default_model = 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022') {
        $this->api_key = trim($api_key);
        $this->default_model = $default_model ?: 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022';
    }

    public function get_id(): string {
        return 'claude';
    }

    public function get_name(): string {
        return 'Anthropic Claude';
    }

    public function is_configured(): bool {
        return !empty($this->api_key);
    }

    public function get_supported_models(): array {
        return [
            'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022' => 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (پیشنهادی - هوشمندترین مدل نگارش و کدنویسی)',
            'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022'  => 'Claude 3.5 Haiku (فوق سریع و سبک با درک بالا)',
            'claude-3-opus-20240229'     => 'Claude 3 Opus (تحلیل عمیق و تخصصی مقالات طولانی)',
            'claude-3-sonnet-20240229'   => 'Claude 3 Sonnet (نسخه استاندارد ۳)',
            'claude-3-haiku-20240307'    => 'Claude 3 Haiku (نسخه اقتصادی ۳)',
        ];
    }

    public function fetch_live_models(): array {
        if (!$this->is_configured()) {
            return $this->get_supported_models();
        }

        $response = wp_remote_get('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models', [
            'headers' => [
                'x-api-key'         => $this->api_key,
                'anthropic-version' => '2023-06-01',
            ],
            'timeout' => 15,
        ]);

        if (is_wp_error($response) || wp_remote_retrieve_response_code($response) !== 200) {
            return $this->get_supported_models();
        }

        $body = json_decode(wp_remote_retrieve_body($response), true);
        if (empty($body['data']) || !is_array($body['data'])) {
            return $this->get_supported_models();
        }

        $models = [];
        $known = $this->get_supported_models();
        foreach ($body['data'] as $m) {
            $id = $m['id'] ?? '';
            $name = $m['display_name'] ?? $id;
            if (!empty($id)) {
                $models[$id] = $known[$id] ?? "{$name} ({$id})";
            }
        }

        return !empty($models) ? $models : $this->get_supported_models();
    }

    public function generate(string $prompt, array $options = []): array {
        if (!$this->is_configured()) {
            throw new \Exception(__('Claude API key is not configured.', 'omni-ai-suite'));
        }

        $model = $options['model'] ?? $this->default_model;
        $url = 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages';

        $payload = [
            'model'      => $model,
            'max_tokens' => intval($options['max_tokens'] ?? 2048),
            'messages'   => [
                ['role' => 'user', 'content' => $prompt],
            ],
        ];

        if (!empty($options['system_prompt'])) {
            $payload['system'] = $options['system_prompt'];
        }

        $response = wp_remote_post($url, [
            'headers' => [
                'Content-Type'      => 'application/json',
                'x-api-key'         => $this->api_key,
                'anthropic-version' => '2023-06-01',
            ],
            'body'    => wp_json_encode($payload),
            'timeout' => 45,
        ]);

        if (is_wp_error($response)) {
            throw new \Exception($response->get_error_message());
        }

        $code = wp_remote_retrieve_response_code($response);
        $body = json_decode(wp_remote_retrieve_body($response), true);

        if ($code !== 200) {
            $msg = $body['error']['message'] ?? __('Failed to generate content from Claude API.', 'omni-ai-suite');
            throw new \Exception("Claude API Error ($code): $msg");
        }

        $text = '';
        if (!empty($body['content']) && is_array($body['content'])) {
            foreach ($body['content'] as $block) {
                if (($block['type'] ?? '') === 'text') {
                    $text .= $block['text'] ?? '';
                }
            }
        }

        $tokens = ($body['usage']['input_tokens'] ?? 0) + ($body['usage']['output_tokens'] ?? 0);

        return [
            'text'     => $text,
            'tokens'   => $tokens,
            'model'    => $model,
            'provider' => $this->get_id(),
        ];
    }

    public function stream(string $prompt, array $options = [], ?callable $chunk_callback = null): void {
        if (!$this->is_configured()) {
            throw new \Exception(__('Claude API key is not configured.', 'omni-ai-suite'));
        }

        $model = $options['model'] ?? $this->default_model;
        $url = 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages';

        $payload = [
            'model'      => $model,
            'max_tokens' => intval($options['max_tokens'] ?? 2048),
            'messages'   => [
                ['role' => 'user', 'content' => $prompt],
            ],
            'stream'     => true,
        ];

        if (!empty($options['system_prompt'])) {
            $payload['system'] = $options['system_prompt'];
        }

        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $url);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, wp_json_encode($payload));
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
            'Content-Type: application/json',
            'x-api-key: ' . $this->api_key,
            'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01',
        ]);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, false);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 120);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);

        $buffer = '';
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION, function ($ch, $data) use (&$buffer, $chunk_callback) {
            $buffer .= $data;
            while (($pos = strpos($buffer, "\n")) !== false) {
                $line = trim(substr($buffer, 0, $pos));
                $buffer = substr($buffer, $pos + 1);

                if (str_starts_with($line, 'data:')) {
                    $json_str = trim(substr($line, 5));
                    if (!empty($json_str)) {
                        $parsed = json_decode($json_str, true);
                        // Claude sends event 'content_block_delta'
                        if (($parsed['type'] ?? '') === 'content_block_delta') {
                            $chunk_text = $parsed['delta']['text'] ?? '';
                            if ($chunk_text !== '') {
                                if ($chunk_callback) {
                                    call_user_func($chunk_callback, $chunk_text);
                                } else {
                                    echo "data: " . wp_json_encode(['text' => $chunk_text, 'done' => false]) . "\n\n";
                                    if (ob_get_level() > 0) {
                                        ob_flush();
                                    }
                                    flush();
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return strlen($data);
        });

        $success = curl_exec($ch);
        $http_code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $error = curl_error($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        if (!$success || $http_code >= 400) {
            $err_msg = $error ? $error : "HTTP status $http_code";
            throw new \Exception("Claude streaming failed: $err_msg");
        }
    }
}
